question: Recommended Dietary Allowances = ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Requirements + Margin of safety**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **RDAs** are **nutrient intake recommendations **developed by the** Food and Nutrition Board of the National Academy of Sciences.**
 
• They are** based on scientific research and designed to provide guidance on the number of nutrients needed **to meet the nutritional needs of healthy individuals in the United States.
